## History

Having brought his young bride to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) five years prior, Mr. Allan served as the town's minister. During a social visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) early in his tenure, he and his wife attended a tea prepared by [Anne](../character/anne.md), where Mrs. Allan accidentally sampled a layer cake flavored with anodyne liniment. Following the sudden death of [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Mr. Allan provided spiritual support and comfort to [Anne](../character/anne.md) as she grieved. His eventual departure from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) was noted by the local community as [Anne](../character/anne.md) completed her tenure as the town's schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Allan first meets [Anne](../character/anne.md) during a tea visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she warmly comforts the young girl after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally flavors a layer cake with liniment instead of vanilla. Following this initial incident, Allan quickly becomes a supportive figure and kindred spirit to [Anne](../character/anne.md) as she grows and matures over the years. She continues to encourage [Anne](../character/anne.md) through various milestones, including her preparations for the entrance examinations and her eventual departure for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>
